Control panel features seven knobs and the brand name 'MAXI' in the center (photo 0).
Cooktop has four gas burners and one central electric hotplate (photo 0).
Oven door has a sticker with 'MAXI', '115L Oven cavity', and 'Double Burner Power' (photo 0).
A power cord with a plug is visible on the left side.
A gas hose and regulator are lying on the floor in front of the unit.
The unit is resting on a piece of cardboard on a tiled floor.

identity.kind: 4 gas and 1 electric burner cooker with oven

claims.evidence: The exterior appears clean in the photo, but internal cleanliness and wear cannot be confirmed.
Functional condition of burners, oven, and electrical components is not shown.
Requires testing of gas flow, ignition, and heating elements.

risks.risk: The electric hotplate may be burnt out or disconnected.
risks.proof: Video showing the hotplate heating up until it glows or boils water.

risks.risk: Oven and grill burners may fail to ignite or stay lit (thermocouple failure).
risks.proof: Video showing both the top and bottom oven burners lit and remaining on for at least 30 seconds.

risks.risk: Gas burners may have uneven flames or clogged jets.
risks.proof: Video showing all four top burners lit simultaneously on high flame.

risks.risk: The electric ignition system for the burners may be faulty.
risks.proof: Video showing the spark ignition lighting the burners without a manual lighter.

proof_requests: Video of all 4 gas burners and the electric hotplate turned on and working.
Video showing the oven and grill burners lit and staying on.
Photo of the technical specification plate, usually found on the back of the cooker.
Confirmation if the seller is 'BELLA NOVE' as indicated by the watermark.
response.reason: The item is a recognizable Maxi 4+1 burner cooker (90cm width based on the 115L cavity claim). It can be priced at its worst-case functional state (oven and electric plate not working) until proof is provided.
